pricing_method.reagent_reference: Frozen non-circular quick, target, and high bands from data/ah-price-baselines.json; exact vendor cost where applicable. Active AH listings are excluded.
pricing_method.crafted_intermediates: Recursively priced from their own audited recipe floors; canonical Enchanting outputs use their current crafted-catalog bands.
pricing_method.output_quantity: Minimum guaranteed output; charged devices use all guaranteed charges.
pricing_method.market_margin: Demand-sensitive margin with upward convenience rounding; frozen output references may preserve an independently established higher posting baseline.
pricing_method.complete_decks: At least the sum of all eight audited card prices plus a small completion premium.
